nodes.text: A repo has named parts, causal tests, and a place two people can stand inside the same object; a chat log has none of those.
Do not collapse the story-why (what the model says it thought) and the machinery-why (which features moved the tokens).
Asking the model "why" returns a commit message; ground truth comes from intervention — ablate, steer, delete a premise, regenerate, observe what changes.
True insight is a source map: bind the sentence the human reads to the circuit that caused it, without claiming they are the same.
"Show me the neurons" is the wrong port. Make thought an object you can inhabit, fork, and break on purpose.
Invent the medium first. Internals plug in later as a deeper sensor on the same objects. Git did not wait for cycle-accurate CPU traces.
A source map binds minified JavaScript to the original file the way a thought-object should bind prose to a circuit.
Fork is `git checkout -b` for a thought; intervention is `git bisect` for cognition.
Three depths share the same thought-objects: visible mind, gray-box causality, source-mapped internals.
Depth 1 must work on any chat model with no internals, including this Grok TUI session.
Treat the model's self-report as ground truth (a more eloquent black box).
A dashboard of neurons — how this idea dies in a lab.
Faithful English inner monologue of the forward pass.
Wait for xAI to open Grok weights before building anything.
Ship a Neuronpedia-style raw circuit explorer as the product.
Grok weights are not available from this chat; Depth 3 needs open weights or a vendor interpretability API.
Rejected alternatives (negative space) are first-class and always stored.
Dual archaeology: human forks and vetoes are first-class; over time a map of how the human thinks against the model.
